title: Finance & Banking
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El vocabulario financiero es esencial para hablar de negocios con autoridad.

parts.visual:
Préstamos y dinero: 
- Loan (Préstamo). 
- Mortgage (Hipoteca - préstamo para una casa). 
- Interest rate (Tasa de interés). 
Ej: We got a loan from the bank with a low interest rate to buy the new office.
parts.audio: Loans and money. Loan. Mortgage is a loan to buy a house. Note the T is silent in mortgage. Interest rate. For example: We got a loan from the bank with a low interest rate to buy the new office.

parts.visual:
Inversiones y resultados: 
- Invest (Invertir). 
- Profit (Ganancia / Beneficio). 
- Loss (Pérdida). 
- Debt (Deuda - la B es muda). 
Ej: If we invest in this technology, we will increase our profit and reduce our debt.
parts.audio: Investments and results. Invest. Profit means the money you make. Loss means the money you lose. Debt means money you owe. Note the B in debt is silent. For example: If we invest in this technology, we will increase our profit and reduce our debt.

questions.question: I applied for a bank ____ to start my business. (Préstamo).
questions.explanation: Loan = préstamo (dinero que el banco te da).

questions.question: She is paying off the ____ on her house. (Hipoteca).
questions.explanation: Mortgage (se pronuncia 'morguech', la T es muda) = hipoteca.

questions.question: The central bank raised the ____ rate to control inflation. (Tasa de interés).
We made a huge ____ this year! ($$$ a favor).
Unfortunately, the company suffered a terrible ____. ($$$ en contra).
He has a lot of credit card ____. (Deuda).
questions.explanation: Debt (se pronuncia 'det', la B es muda) = deuda.

questions.question: It's a good time to ____ in the stock market. (Invertir).
You need to pay your income ____ before April. (Impuestos).
We need to cut costs because our ____ is too low. (Margen de ganancia).
I need to open a new bank ____. (Cuenta).
She made a cash ____ of $500. (Retiro).
questions.explanation: Withdrawal = retiro (sacar dinero). Deposit = depósito (meter dinero).

questions.question: The company went ____ because they couldn't pay their debts. (A la quiebra / Bancarrota).
questions.explanation: Go bankrupt = ir a la bancarrota / quebrar.

questions.question: What is the ____ rate between the Dollar and the Euro today? (Tasa de cambio).
The company's total ____ is over 5 million dollars. (Ingresos).
questions.explanation: Revenue = ingresos (dinero total que entra antes de descontar gastos). Profit = ganancia (lo que queda limpio).

questions.question: He works as a financial ____ for a big bank. (Asesor).
I need to ____ some money to your account. (Transferir).
A ____ market is when stock prices are falling. (Mercado bajista).
questions.explanation: Bear market = mercado a la baja. Bull market = mercado al alza.

questions.question: A ____ is a small piece of ownership in a company. (Acción bursátil).
questions.explanation: Share (o stock) = acción de una empresa.

questions.question: The ____ rate. (Tasa de interés con I)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración financiera correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I applied for a bank loan.
options: I applied for a bank loan.
I applied for a bank line.
I applied for a bank mortgage.
I applied for a bank account.
questions.correct_answer: I applied for a bank loan.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She is paying off the mortgage.
options: She is paying off the mortgage.
She is paying off the loan.
She is paying off the debt.
He is paying off the mortgage.
questions.correct_answer: She is paying off the mortgage.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The interest rate is very high.
options: The interest rate is very high.
The interest rate is very low.
The exchange rate is very high.
questions.correct_answer: The interest rate is very high.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: He has a lot of debt.
options: He has a lot of debt.
She has a lot of debt.
He has a lot of money.
He has a lot of loans.
questions.correct_answer: He has a lot of debt.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It's a good time to invest.
options: It's a good time to invest.
It's a good time to buy.
It's a good time to sell.
Is it a good time to invest?
questions.correct_answer: It's a good time to invest.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: You need to pay your taxes.
options: You need to pay your taxes.
You need to pay your debts.
You need to pay your loans.
I need to pay my taxes.
questions.correct_answer: You need to pay your taxes.
